WITH grouped_data AS (
  SELECT
    $__timeGroup("end", '1h') AS time,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM
    "beep"
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter("end")
  GROUP BY
    time
)
SELECT
  time,
  AVG(count) AS average_count
FROM
  grouped_data
GROUP BY
  time

spec.description: Tells you beeps per hour at a given point in time
spec.title: Average Beeps Per Hour over selected time period

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("end" - "start")) / 60 AS duration
  FROM
    "beep"
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter("end")
  GROUP BY
    "end", "start"

SELECT
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ("end" - "start")) / 60 AS duration
  FROM
    "beep"
  WHERE
    $__timeFilter("end") AND "status" = 'complete'
  GROUP BY
    "end", "start"

spec.description: Tells you beeps per hour at a given point in time
spec.title: Average Beeps Per Hour over selected time period

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias(created, '1h'),
  SUM(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY min(created)) + (SELECT count(*) from "user" where created is NULL)  AS users
FROM
  "user"
WHERE
  created < $__timeTo(created)
GROUP BY created
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("end", '1h'),
  SUM(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY min("end")) AS beeps
FROM
  "beep"
WHERE
  "end" < $__timeTo("end")
GROUP BY "end"
ORDER BY 1

spec.description: Total beeps (including canceled, denied, completed, etc..)
spec.title: Beeps

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("end", '1h'),
  SUM(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY min("end"))  AS total
FROM
  "beep"
WHERE
  "end" < $__timeTo("end")
GROUP BY "end"
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("end", '1h'),
  SUM(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY min("end")) AS complete
FROM
  "beep"
WHERE
  "status" = 'complete' AND
  "end" < $__timeTo("end")
GROUP BY "end"
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("end", '1h'),
  SUM(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY min("end")) AS denied
FROM
  "beep"
WHERE
  "status" = 'denied' AND
  "end" < $__timeTo("end")
GROUP BY "end"
ORDER BY 1

SELECT
  $__timeGroupAlias("end", '1h'),
  SUM(count(*)) OVER (ORDER BY min("end")) AS canceled
FROM
  "beep"
WHERE
  "status" = 'canceled' AND
  "end" < $__timeTo("end")
GROUP BY "end"
ORDER BY 1
SELECT count(*) as total, status FROM beep GROUP BY status LIMIT 50
SELECT count(*) as total, substring(email from '@(.*)$') as domain FROM "user" GROUP BY domain order by total desc
